title: AssemblyReviewResult
description: Hallucination review of ArticleAssembly title/summary and per-section title/content against source articles. Nested cover + sections structure forces the reviewer to report a verdict for every section.

verdict.description: REJECT iff any patch is emitted anywhere in cover.patches or sections[].patches; ACCEPT otherwise.

cover.description: Judgment for the Gem cover (title + summary). Must always be present.

status.description: 'fail' iff at least one patch targets a cover field (title / summary[i].*).

patches.description: Patches targeting title / summary[i].{subHeader,text}. Empty when status is 'pass'.

claim_checks.description: Exactly one receipt per required_claim_audit item, in the same order.

claim_id.description: Exact claim_id from the corresponding required_claim_audit item.

result.description: PASS when the complete claim is supported and has no material defect; FLAGGED otherwise.

source_ids.description: Relevant content IDs copied from ground_sources; empty only when no source applies.

audit_basis.description: Concise semantic comparison of the complete claim with relevant source context.

sections.description: One entry per section in the input generated_content.sections[], in the SAME order. Every section must have an entry — do not skip. The reviewer is responsible for auditing every section, not just the ones that look problematic.

status.description: 'pass' iff this section's title and content have no defect; 'fail' iff at least one patch is emitted for either field.

patches.description: Patches targeting sections[i].title or sections[i].content. Empty when status is 'pass'.

claim_id.description: A FLAGGED claim_id authorizing this patch.

field_path.description: Which field this patch targets. Allowed: 'title', 'summary[0..2].{subHeader,text}', 'sections[i].title', 'sections[i].content'. For sections[i].content, `original` is one or more complete verbatim sentences appearing exactly once. Patches inside cover.patches must target title or summary[i].*; patches inside sections[k].patches must target sections[k].* (matching index).

original.description: Verbatim current value of the field, or one-or-more complete sentences for sections[i].content patches. Used by the tool to sanity-check before applying.

replacement.description: Grounded new value preserving the field's type, tone, language, and shape.

supporting_sources.description: Verbatim quotes from GROUND SOURCES that support the replacement. Every concrete claim in the replacement must be covered.

content_id.description: content_id from GROUND SOURCES. For a sections[k] patch, a verified source missing from section_source_index[k].cites is added to that facet; cover patches may use any ground source.

quote.description: Verbatim contiguous sentence or span copied from that source's text. Join non-adjacent spans with ' ... ' if needed.

reason.description: Concise explanation of why the original is a hallucination against the sources.

confidence.description: Reviewer's confidence in the reported error. This field is informational and does not control patch application.
